description: This file defines the PreviewThemeAPI class, which provides API endpoints for previewing theme color variables in a Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for creating a theme preview and stubs for retrieving or deleting themes. The class uses traits for theme service operations and variable validation rules, and is part of the OrangeHRM Corporate Branding API namespace. The primary functionality involves processing theme variable input and returning derived CSS variables.

classes.name: PreviewThemeAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for previewing theme variables, handling creation of theme previews by processing input variables and returning derived CSS variables.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Throws a not implemented exception; the method is part of the CollectionEndpoint interface.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns a not implemented exception for validation rules for 'getAll'.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Processes theme variables from request body, generates derived CSS variables via ThemeService, and returns them as an ArrayModel.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns the validation rules for creating a theme preview, retrieved from trait method.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Throws a not implemented exception; intended for deleting a theme or preview but not implemented.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns a not implemented exception for validation rules for delete.
